scope: real streaming endpoint; token rates are aggregate observed usage divided by wall time, not server-internal kernel rates; critical-path latency is reported separately
gpu_sampling_note: 30-second point samples observed device memory and power but did not intersect an active kernel; no GPU-utilization claim is made
kv_capacity_evidence: the native CUDA endpoint exposed no resident-KV capacity counter; no KV-capacity claim is made; independent samples observed 2312 MiB peak device memory
queue_evidence: 10,000 contexts were accepted into one bounded host queue; two physical workers drove model turns; 9,998 nonresident context records were actually parked and byte-identically restored before the run; endpoint peak in-flight was 3 including the independent probe; per-item queue age was not exposed, so no queue-age percentile claim is made
result_check: transport, nonempty completion, exact provider usage, and exact retirement contract; all 10,000 measured streams carried usage and nonempty text; four provider transient failures were recovered within the three-attempt ceiling; not semantic task quality
